title: North campus: modelled ground past every edge
caption: Behind head office, every way you look now ends in built things: the platform shed instead of a grey box, the canteen's loading yard behind a closed gate where the service lane used to stop on bare grass, the office street with its offices across it, pines along the sea wall and a wood east of quarter street. Try it with ?place=campus&day=2.

sections.title: The platform shed from the rest garden
sections.caption: South of the bench court the shed was a plain box from the skyline. The campus builds the real shed now, the same model as the forecourt's.

sections.title: The service lane's end
sections.caption: The lane stopped at a kerb on the grass a few metres short of the canteen's yard. It ends at a closed gate now, with the yard built past it: shutter, crates, bins and the walk to m6's door.

sections.title: North to the office street
sections.caption: Past the quarter and shed streets' mouths the office street was flat colour and the offices plain boxes. Now the street has its verge, lamps and bench bays, and the offices across it their doors, canopies and names.

sections.title: West to the sea
sections.caption: Ten metres of empty grass ran from the coast walk to the sea wall. A strip of pines stands along the wall now.
